messages:
Priya: Quick ping — final panel for Avery Chen tomorrow 11:30am PT. Two quick checks before we lock: recording consent, rubric owner, and scribe. Can people confirm?
Samir P: I can be the scribe. happy to capture notes + top takeaways.
Elena G: AV booked for onsite room A; remote link needed. who has the Zoom?
Priya: thx Samir. @Elena G I’ll post the Zoom in 30m. reminder: candidate asked for captioning — please enable live captions.
Maya K: Rubric lead — I can own scoring weights and send one-pager. FYI I’ll highlight system-design scale and infra tradeoffs section.
Priya: perfect. Can someone confirm recording consent capture script? copy/paste below: 
Priya: ```Hi Avery — just confirming we’ll record this interview for internal note-taking only. If you’re uncomfortable we can stop recording. Do you consent?```
Elena G: good script. +1 to captions.
Samir P: also will note timebox per section: 15m intros, 35m design, 10m wrap.
Priya: thanks. Folks, small ask: after the panel, drop one bullet per person in #hiring-notes with score + 1-sentence rationale. helps faster sync.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder set — please submit post-interview notes within 24h: https://forms.internal/submit-notes (auto-reminder will ping panel 12h after interview). :bell:
Maya K: sent rubric one-pager to this thread (uploaded). editing: mark question 4 as optional if time runs short.
Priya: amazing, appreciate it. last thing — can someone confirm calendar invite lists 'Recording: Yes' in description?
Elena G: updated invite desc. all set from AV side.
Samir P: got it. I’ll take the debrief lead at 12:15pm for 15m.
Priya: awesome, closing loop — all set. thanks everyone! :tada:
